function_role: Implements the MSVC array unwind helper function `__ArrayUnwind`, which iterates backwards through an array of objects during exception handling, invoking the element destructor on each remaining item.

callsite_summaries.0x00419DE8: Initializes standard Structured Exception Handling (SEH) prolog at the start of the function, setting up the exception frame using local stack variables and a scope table descriptor.
callsite_summaries.0x00419E2D: Tears down the Structured Exception Handling (SEH) frame and restores the stack pointer just before the function returns successfully.
